name: 28982-mtpdecode-dsv4flashfp8-tp8
model: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 -- the FP8 repackage; upstream `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` has FP4 routed experts that want Blackwell or the marlin runner.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=8, PP=1, DP=1, expert-parallel load balancing on. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM, 43 layers, hidden 4096, MLA plus DeepSeek sparse attention, 256 routed experts + 1 shared at top-6, one nextn head, block-FP8 weights, 294.1 GB.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=160, bounded at 1280 requests with a 5400 s safety cap, warmup the first 25%.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix structure: 4096 prompt tokens and 1500 output tokens, both fixed, output pinned by `ignore_eos` and sampled greedily (temperature 0). Seed 42.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant generating 1500-token answers from 4096-token prompts for 160 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
model-path: sgl-project/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8
trust-remote-code: true

# ep-size is not implied by tp-size: it defaults to 1, and EPLB asserts ep_size > 1.
tp-size: 8
ep-size: 8

enable-eplb: true
eplb-rebalance-layers-per-chunk: 1

# EAGLE with topk 1 is asserted for this architecture.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# Explicit because the speculative startup hook writes 48 into this field whenever it is still
# unset, which would cap the closed loop at under a third of its declared load.
max-running-requests: 256

# The request-to-token pool is max_running_requests x context_length int32, so the checkpoint's
# declared 1048576 asks ~1 TB per rank. The longest request here is 4096 + 1500 = 5596 tokens.
context-length: 8192

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

error.text: both versions' own code crashes while capturing the draft model's CUDA graphs in this setup (expert load balancing on)
